card.name: Marked by / characterized by phrases
card.fires_on: The word 'marked' or 'by' in 'was marked by', 'characterized by', or 'permeated with', describing a quality of a person, religion, or era. Also the 'prints' in the repeated 'Blueprints For Travel' citation.

modes.label: Marked/characterized by
modes.description: Verbs or participles of description that lead into 'by' and a defining trait.
modes.example: his private life was<< marked>> by sanctity and austerity.
